notes: Complete OHD short-bark/command library translated from JPN authority. Four contiguous shards. Exact OHD auxiliary mapping was generally useful but semantic mismatches were corrected from JPN (notably すまなかった, 異常なし, ターゲット捕捉, 合体, 避けろ, 突っ込むぞ, 好きになれん). Latin stylized commands GO! GO! GO!, VIC BOSS!, VIC VOS! were preserved. No control tokens occur in the mapped OHD rows; longest Chinese translation is 36 UTF-8 bytes, safely below the 128-byte record size before final builder validation.
